term.title: Search term
term.description: Full-text search across Federal Register documents, e.g. "artificial intelligence", "PFAS", "tariff". Leave empty to return everything matching your other filters.

documentTypes.title: Document type
documentTypes.description: Restrict to specific document types. Leave empty for all.

publishedAfter.title: Published on or after
publishedAfter.description: ISO date, e.g. "2026-01-01". Combine with the field below for a range.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many documents. Maximum 50000.

agencies.title: Agency slugs
agencies.description: Restrict to agencies by Federal Register slug, e.g. "environmental-protection-agency", "food-and-drug-administration", "securities-and-exchange-commission".
